camel_example: aliyun dcdn DescribeDcdnDomainCcActivityLog --region cn-hangzhou --EndTime '2015-12-10T21:05:00Z' --PageSize 30 --DomainName 'example.com' --PageNumber 1 --StartTime '2015-12-10T20:00:00Z' --Value '10.10.10.10' --TriggerObject IP --RuleName test2
description_en: Call DescribeDcdnDomainCcActivityLog to query logs of requests blocked by CC protection rules
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainCcActivityLog查询频次控制规则拦截日志
kebab_example: aliyun dcdn describe-dcdn-domain-cc-activity-log --domain-name example.com --start-time 2015-12-10T20:00:00Z --end-time 2015-12-10T21:05:00Z --trigger-object IP --value 10.10.10.10 --rule-name test2 --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDcdnDomainCcActivityLog

parameters.help_en:
The accelerated domain name to query. You can specify multiple domain names separated by commas (,).

If you leave this parameter empty, data for all your accelerated domain names is returned
parameters.help_zh:
需要查询的加速域名。支持批量域名查询，多个域名用半角逗号（,）分隔。

若该参数为空，默认返回所有加速域名合并后数据
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The minimum data granularity is 5 minutes.

If you do not specify this parameter, data from the last 24 hours is returned
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的起始时间点。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

最小数据粒度为5分钟。

若该参数为空，默认读取过去24小时数据
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的结束时间点。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The object that triggers the rate limiting rule.

If you leave this parameter empty, all block events are queried
parameters.help_zh:
触发对象。

若该参数为空，则查询所有拦截事件
parameters.name: trigger_object

parameters.help_en:
The value of the trigger object.

If you leave this parameter empty, all block events are queried
parameters.help_zh:
触发对象值。

若该参数为空，则查询所有拦截事件
parameters.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The name of the rule.

Normal mode: default_normal

Emergency mode: default_attack

Custom mode: a custom rule name, such as test2.

If you leave this parameter empty, all block events are queried
parameters.help_zh:
规则名称。

正常模式：default_normal；

紧急模式：default_attack；

自定义模式：用户自定义规则名称，例如test2。


若该参数为空，则查询所有拦截事件
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 30
parameters.name: page_size

RuleName.description_en: The name of the block rule

TimeStamp.description_en: The beginning of the time slice

Ttl.description_en: The period during which the rule is effective, in seconds

Value.description_en: The value of the trigger object

PageIndex.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned on each page

Total.description_en: The total number of entries returned
